pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level gradients. Patch area is significantly larger on the upper flank and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the lower limbs and ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space lattice of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-directional. Pathway thickness is relatively narrow compared to patch diameter, maintaining a consistent width across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck curve exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D silhouette against the blurred background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark, teardrop-shaped mass is visible on the ventral midline near the posterior flank boundary, appearing as a localized protrusion from the body contour.
